data.name: DnsRecordTypeADescription
data.value: Points a name to an IPv4 address.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeAaaaDescription
data.value: Points a name to an IPv6 address.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeCnameDescription
data.value: Makes a name an alias of another name.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeMxDescription
data.value: Names the server that receives mail for the domain, with a preference.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeTxtDescription
data.value: Holds text, such as SPF, DKIM and verification values.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeSrvDescription
data.value: Locates a service by priority, weight, port and host.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeCaaDescription
data.value: Says which certificate authorities may issue certificates for the domain.

data.name: DnsRecordTypeNsDescription
data.value: Delegates a name below the zone to other name servers.
